arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test different timezone formats with ti
fmt = 'a {:ti} b'

tests = [
    'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b',   # +NNMM format
    'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b',  # +NN:MM format
    'a 1997-07-16T19:20Z b',       # Z format
    'a 1997-07-16T19:20 +0100 b',  # +NNMM with space
    'a 1997-07-16T19:20 +01:00 b', # +NN:MM with space
]

for t in tests:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, t)
    if result:
        tz = result[0].tzinfo
        print(f'{t:45} -> name={tz._name}, offset={tz._offset}')
    else:
        print(f'{t:45} -> None')
"
